text:
maria: heads up — after rolling the nvidia-container-toolkit -> 1.5.x on the eu-west GPU pool some pods started OOM/killing at startup. container logs show missing libcuda/libnvidia-ml at runtime.

ken: roughly how many nodes impacted? any node labels in common?

maria: ~8 nodes so far, all NGC instance-types (g5/g4), mixed kernel versions (5.15/5.19). happened shortly after the baseimage + toolkit bump in the canary ASG.

vikram: can you paste a sample error?

maria: ```
FAILED TO START runtime: dlopen failed: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so.1: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory
Caused by: failed to load nvidia-ml: open /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libnvidia-ml.so.1: no such file or directory
```

olivia: that looks like the toolkit upgrade changed the install path (now under /usr/lib/nvidia) and our hostPath mounts in the device-plugin sidecar don't match. mountPropagation/Bind mode maybe required.

maria: interesting — kubelet shows our hostPath mounts as default (not RShared). some containers still get libs via host mount, others do not.

ken: immediate mitigation — can we add an initContainer that copies host libs into the pod filesystem and update LD_LIBRARY_PATH? quick patch to unblock. sample:```
initContainers:
- name: copy-nvidia-libs
  image: busybox
  command: ["sh","-c","cp -a /host/usr/lib/nvidia/* /tmp/nvidia-libs || cp -a /host/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/* /tmp/nvidia-libs"]
  volumeMounts:
  - mountPath: /host
    name: host-root
```
(add hostRoot and mountPropagation HostToContainer on host-root)
```
env:
- name: LD_LIBRARY_PATH
  value: /tmp/nvidia-libs:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
```

vikram: that should work as stopgap. but longer term we need kubelet/hyperkube mountPropagation set to Bidirectional or update device-plugin to the new paths. also check driver-kernel compatibility — if driver package moved layout, older drivers might not find modules.

olivia: canary rollback plan: roll baseimage/toolkit in canary ASG back to 1.4.x, drain + reprovision affected nodes, then run a small canary with instrumented pods that validate lib paths.

infra-oncall-bot: [deploy] rollback initiated by @olivia for asg/gpu-eu-west-canary at 1976543285

maria: created a small k8s Job that tries the initContainer copy approach and writes out which paths exist, giving us per-node variance. dropping link: http://logs/redwood/gpu-toolkit-probe (internal)

ken: :thumbsup: once rollback is confirmed good we should add an automated probe in our node-prober to detect expected nvidia lib locations and mount propagation correctness before future toolkit upgrades. filing infra ticket.

maria: filing notes: observed nodes had either toolkit-installed libs under /usr/lib/nvidia OR symlinks in /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu that got lost when mount propagation changed. root cause hypothesis: toolkit package changed install location + our hostPath/propagation assumptions.

vikram: followups: (1) add initContainer workaround to affected daemonsets production-wide only if rollback delayed, (2) update churn-doc for toolkit upgrades + required kubelet flags, (3) test on a repro node with both kernel versions.

olivia: i'll coordinate rollback and post results in this thread. tagging @ken for probe automation.

infra-oncall-bot: incident-note added, severity: high, affected_pools: eu-west-gpu, action: canary rollback in progress

maria: thanks all — will keep thread updated with job output and rollback status. :white_check_mark:
